items.title: awesome-jev
items.summary: A curated list of Jev use cases, projects, SDKs, and resources. Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model for fast, typed decisions in software — Choice, Score, and Noul with calibrated probabilities.

items.title: ai-apis-you-can-ship-today

items.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
items.title_cn: 具有安全机器人操纵障碍感知线束的编码代理

items.summary: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. items.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
items.title_cn: FAMOS ：稀疏观测的前馈3D关节建模
items.summary: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence.
